title: Framework version disclosed (X-AspNetMvc-Version header)
description: The response advertises the ASP.NET MVC version in X-AspNetMvc-Version. The header is emitted by default in older framework versions and turns a generic endpoint into a version-specific target for exploit selection.
remediation: Remove the header in the application configuration (MvcHandler.DisableMvcResponseHeader) or at the reverse proxy. Keep version information in server-side inventory rather than in responses.
limitation: One header value. The rule reports the advertised version; it does not claim the version is vulnerable.
